Jesus... she sent my hoodie back by courier today. No note. I still checked the pockets. 📦

Prayer for a broken heart after a breakup.

His ex returned his hoodie by courier with no note, and he still checked the pockets for a message.

Jesus: “What you gave was real. Love given honestly is never wasted.”

“The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.”
Psalm 34:18 (BSB)

Put the hoodie away. Don't put your heart away.

💬 What would you have hoped to find in the pocket?

youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus, answered from Scripture.

Prayer for a broken heart after a breakup.

He: Jesus... she sent my hoodie back by courier today. No note. I still checked the pockets. 📦
He: I told my friends it's just a hoodie. I haven't opened the bag since.
Jesus: You checked the pockets for proof she still cared.
He: Was any of it real, or was it just me?
Jesus: What you gave was real. Love given honestly is never wasted.
Jesus: Put the hoodie away. Don't put your heart away.

“The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.”
Psalm 34:18 (BSB)

💬 What would you have hoped to find in the pocket?
